title: Emergency declaration EM-3635-TN: Winter Storm
summary: FEMA records a emergency declaration (EM-3635-TN, "SEVERE WINTER STORM") for TN, dated 2026-01-24, for an incident of type "Winter Storm". The incident period began on 2026-01-22 and ended on 2026-01-27. The declaration lists 95 designated areas.
